request.text: 请在账户设置中选择你喜欢的颜色，并将发货地址设为办公室地址。新版本优化了收藏夹，方便你整理常用内容。
request.style: 友好、简洁的产品说明；采用目标地区自然的拼写与用词

initial_translation: Please select your preferred color in the account settings and set your shipping address to your office address. The latest version has improved the bookmark feature, making it easier for you to organize frequently used content.
